title: HealPhi
tagline: A place to heal yourself before you hit your rock bottom being an anon.
description:
Pseudo- Anonymous place to bring the discussion around the mental health.
Using the anonymous identities to make a safe place to dis`cuss their mental health issues, providing a place for psychologist to carry out the discussion and spread awareness around different mental health issues.
how_its_made:
We are using Huddle01 for powering the real-time interaction between the psychologist and the users, powering the tipping feature over GHO token.
On sign-up people get access to X amount of free GHO token. For sign-up we use connect kit to allow the seamless experience for the on boarding of the user.
